acceptance: four cells complete with run-health passing; per-cell rates measured at exact 1 ms-binned spike counts; the verdict is exactly one of the five predeclared labels computed from the viability pattern; synchrony and the mode reported, not gating

BASELINE.meaning: exact rebuild of the SCI-EI-REGIME-1 intact arm; no repair

W_ONLY.meaning: weight repair only: mean realized E->PV and E->VIP weights to parity with realized E->E

A_ONLY.meaning: adaptation repair only: SST a to canonical LTS

BOTH.meaning: both repairs; interaction and closure cell

authority: owner 2026-09-19 assessment: 2x2 factorial W_EI {current, repaired} by SST_a {current, canonical}; repaired values from independent authority, never rate-tuned; verdict mapping predeclared; no tuning after seeing the four cells. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as SCI-EI-INTERACTION-1

diagnostic_hypotheses.scope: causal factorial over the two supported EI-REGIME-1 candidates (C2 weak weights, C3 SST adaptation); C1 and C4 read negative and are not varied

additive_changes: per-cell repair application after EQUAL_G with construction-identity asserts against the EI diagnosis receipt
per-cell viability, synchrony and mode reporting; classification lives in scripts/whole_system_ei_interaction_compare.py
driver.why_forked: a sealed artifact is not edited. The fork is additive and the source is unchanged

duration.derivation: copied verbatim from the SCI-EI-REGIME-1 intact arm

estimator: rates are exact binned counts, not estimates. Mode by jomission.harness.oscillation.measure (sealed estimator) on pooled E over the final 1000 ms with max_lag 500 ms and 200 surrogates; reported, never gating. The verdict is a classification over predeclared viability, not a threshold crossing

frozen.everything: the SCI-EI-REGIME-1 intact construction: architecture, realizer, tonic drive, seed, weight, probability and mechanism taus, retinal interface, stimulus definition
frozen.tonic: nominal E 5.0 (realized cortical mean verified), PV 3.0, SST 3.5, VIP 3.0, Retina 0.0

kernel.authority: reviewer 2026-09-18 via the OSC-1 intact arm (copied verbatim; the qualified scientific lineage executed kernel=baseline)
kernel.hdp_off_reason: HDP is OFF (copied from the OSC-1 intact arm)

principal_delta: two predeclared repairs, factorially combined, on the sealed intact construction. Nothing else changes
question: do repaired E->I weights, canonical SST adaptation, or only their joint application produce a viable cortical E-I regime

repairs.tolerances: realized means asserted within 1e-6 of receipt (covers 6-decimal rounding); SST a asserted exact

weight_parity.authority: parity with the realized E->E mean, an internal reference never touched by rate targets
weight_parity.rule: scale every realized E->PV edge by wee/wepv and every E->VIP edge by wee/wevip, multiplicatively, sign and distribution shape preserved

sst_canonical_LTS.rule: set SST entries of the emitter a array to exactly 0.02; b stays 0.25, c and d untouched

runs.note: visualization probe only through the sealed driver (identical base construction); not used for rates

stop_condition: four cells, then STOP. No tuning after seeing the four cells; viability is classification against ratified bands, never a tuning target; no calibration

verdict_mapping.viable: PV in [12,25] and VIP in [8,15] and SST in [6,12] and E < PV (ratified B1 globals)

visualization_contract.rule: V0 and V1 of the baseline construction are rendered and looked at before any interpretation or execution. V1's ordering and window are reused verbatim by V2. Repaired cells differ by documented parameter deltas; their evidence is numerical
